results.name: Xuixo
results.short_description: Deep-fried laminated pastry filled with crema catalana and coated in sugar. Invented at Pastisseria Puig on Carrer de la Cort Reial in Girona in the 1920s. Designated a Producte de la Terra by the Catalan government. Girona hosts the annual Concurs Mundial del Xuixo (World Xuixo Contest) since 2018.
results.strength_of_local_association: Very strong — invented in and iconic to Girona city

results.name: Botifarra dolça
results.short_description: A sweet sausage of medieval origin, made with pork, sugar, lemon zest and cinnamon, available fresh or cured. Its legend is tied to the Jardins de la Francesa behind Girona Cathedral.
results.strength_of_local_association: Very strong — specifically a Girona city tradition

results.name: Poma de Girona
results.short_description: Apples grown in the plains of Gironès, Baix Empordà and Alt Empordà, holding a Protected Geographical Indication (IGP). Traditional cultivation in the region since ancient times.
results.strength_of_local_association: Strong — carries the Girona name in its IGP designation

results.name: Ratafia
results.short_description: A sweet herbal liqueur made by macerating green walnuts and local herbs and spices in spirit. Deeply rooted in Girona's gastronomic identity and commonly offered alongside xuixos on food tours.
results.strength_of_local_association: Strong — traditional Girona and surrounding area drink

results.name: Empordà olive oil
results.short_description: Extra-virgin olive oil produced from Argudell and other local olive varieties in the Empordà plains surrounding Girona. Holds DO Empordà status.

results.name: Empordà wines and cavas
results.short_description: Wines and sparkling cavas produced under the DO Empordà appellation from vineyards in the immediate Girona surroundings and Costa Brava hinterland.
results.strength_of_local_association: Strong — listed by Girona City Council as a signature local product

results.name: Embotits gironins
results.short_description: Artisanal cured sausages and cold cuts (fuet, llonganissa, bull) produced in the Girona area, traditionally sold at the Mercat del Lleó in Girona.
results.strength_of_local_association: Strong — core Girona market and gastronomy staple

results.name: Pa amb tomàquet
results.short_description: Toasted bread rubbed with ripe tomato, drizzled with olive oil and salt. While pan-Catalan, it is the standard accompaniment to Girona's local cheeses and embotits and a centrepiece of Girona food culture.
results.strength_of_local_association: Moderate — pan-Catalan but integral to Girona dining

results.name: Chocolates de Girona
results.short_description: Artisan chocolates inspired by the legends and history of the city (e.g. the Girona fly motif). Girona has a notable chocolate-making tradition.
results.strength_of_local_association: Moderate-strong — specifically themed to Girona's legends

results.name: Crema catalana
results.short_description: A custard dessert with caramelised sugar top, closely linked to Girona as the filling of the xuixo and a staple of local restaurant menus. While broadly Catalan, it is inseparable from Girona's pastry identity.
results.strength_of_local_association: Moderate — broadly Catalan but deeply embedded in Girona cuisine
